start: Member page of a member whose plan runs till a day next week and who paid a joining fee

user_sees: Sheet titled 'Renew membership'
'For <name> · valid till <day>'
'Starts on' is the day after the current plan ends, with 'The day after their current plan ends (<last day>).'
Joining fee placeholder ₹0 and 'Already paid a joining fee before, so it is not charged again.'
must_not: A start of today, inside days already paid for
The joining fee in the total
The hint naming the wrong last day

user_sees: 'Membership saved. Receipt <number>.'
Valid till on the member page moves to the end of the new plan
must_not: The current plan cut short or changed
A question about a far start date for the usual renewal day

start: Member whose plan ended last month (other kind: a lapsed member)

steps.action: Open the sell sheet from the member page
user_sees: Title 'Sell membership'
'Starts on' today
Joining fee ₹0 with 'Already paid a joining fee before, so it is not charged again.'
must_not: The start set to the day after the old plan ended (in the past)
The joining fee charged a second time

user_sees: The member becomes active from today
must_not: The gap days counted as paid

start: Member brought in from the old register with one plan (other kind: imported member)

user_sees: Joining fee ₹0 and the 'Already paid a joining fee before' hint, although the imported plan carries no fee
must_not: A joining fee due on the first renewal of an imported member

start: Renew membership sheet open; current plan runs till the 20th

user_sees: Under Starts on: 'They already have a plan from <start> to <end>. Start the new plan after that.' or 'Their plan already runs till <day>. Start the new plan after that.'
must_not: The same days sold twice

steps.action: Clear the date so it is not a full day, tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: 'The start date looks wrong. Pick it again.'
must_not: A plan saved with an unreadable start day

steps.action: Put the date back and type the plan's joining fee in 'Joining fee', tap 'Confirm'
user_sees: The sale is saved with the fee, with no question asked (the question only compares with the plan’s listed fee)
must_not: A fee the member already paid charged without the person at the desk noticing

start: Member who already renewed once: one plan running, one upcoming

user_sees: 'Starts on' is the day after the UPCOMING plan ends, not after the running one
must_not: A third plan starting inside the renewal already bought

steps.action: Cancel the upcoming plan, open the sheet again
user_sees: 'Starts on' goes back to the day after the running plan
must_not: A hole left where the cancelled plan was

steps.action: Renew a plan that was paid ahead and has not started yet (no plan running today)
user_sees: Title 'Renew membership'
Start is the day after that upcoming plan ends
must_not: The new plan started today on top of the weeks already paid for
